results.question: What is this document about?
results.answer: This document is RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics, authored by R. Fielding, Ed.; M. Nottingham, Ed.; and J. Reschke, Ed., and published by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) in June 2022. It describes the overall architecture of HTTP, establishes common terminology, and defines protocol aspects shared by all versions, including core protocol elements, extensibility mechanisms, and the "http" and "https" URI schemes. [document]
